title: Banner Workflow 16:9 Dual Neon Light (Electric Cyan & Magenta)
description: Tạo poster infographic 16:9 phong cách Dual Neon Light phát sáng rực rỡ (Cyan #00F0FF & Magenta #FF007F) nổi bật trên nền Obsidian Carbon tối.
author: Tôi Là Tùng
template: 16:9 horizontal widescreen luxury B2B tech workflow infographic poster, 1920x1080px. Framed by a vibrant glowing dual Neon Light border frame (electric cyan #00f0ff merging into electric magenta #ff007f glow frame). Dark matte obsidian carbon background (#05070f) with subtle laser grid lines. Top center features clean gold text watermark 'toilatung.com' perfectly centered at the top. Below top-center watermark, high hierarchy typography reads 'LEXI AI CONTROL CENTER 2.0' in bold crisp white text and 'Gemini 3.6 Flash & Google Antigravity 2.0' in glowing gold (#ffb800). In the center, a clean 3-layer glassmorphic workflow diagram: Left node labeled 'HARNESS LAYER' with glowing cyan database icons; Center node 'LEXI AI ORCHESTRATOR' featuring a circular glowing gold neon badge with realistic portrait of female AI Manager (beautiful young Asian woman with brown wavy hair and neat white shirt); Right node 'MULTI-AGENT GRAPH ENGINE' connecting 3 sleek badges (Marketing, Content, CRM) to a glowing green checkmark badge 'LOOP QUALITY AUDIT'. Bright glowing neon cyan and golden data pipelines flow smoothly across nodes. Ultra-clean UI/UX design, stunning neon light presentation, perfectly centered watermark.
